Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Stratus has been running the evaluation and we hit a snag in the clinical data ingestion step that will take longer than we anticipated to validate. Procurement also paused the purchasing paperwork until we complete the extra checks.

Anjali — thanks for the heads up and for sending the checklist. I appreciate you surfacing the procurement hold early.

Short summary from our side: moving the acceptance date out ~3 weeks is doable, but it will change the committed close date in our MAP and could affect the timeline for the reserved capacity we set aside. To keep things moving, I've attached an updated MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) with two pragmatic options for Stratus:

1) Rebaseline: accept a 21-day extension to the evaluation, shift final acceptance to 2028-07-21 and preserve current pricing/prioritization. We would update the MAP milestones and push the cutover by the same offset.

2) Staged acceptance: keep the original close date for a partial acceptance (API smoke + pilot dataset), then complete full acceptance by 2028-07-21. This protects some of your go-live timing while giving the team extra time to validate ingestion.

If either option works for you, please confirm by Friday 2028-06-16 so we can lock vendor commitments. If you need us to propose credit or short-term SLA concessions, we can do that as well — I will loop internal stakeholders.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx

Best,
Soin Lee
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding Stratus' ask. External requests a 3-week evaluation extension; procurement is on hold. They suggested 2028-07-21 as new acceptance.

Quick ask: I need a short menu of options we can offer (credit, staged acceptance, sandbox SLA, or an executive touchpoint) plus a recommended escalation threshold (e.g., if final acceptance slips past X date then escalate to Sales Leadership).

My goal is to keep the deal viable without over-committing capacity. Consider:
- Financial impact (revenue slip / reserved GPU contention)
- Support/SE burn for extended validation windows
- Precedent: we don't want to create a long-term expectation for 60+ day acceptance shifts without governance

Draft thinking:
- Offer a one-time 2-week credit on committed billing if they pick Rebaseline option 1.
- Offer a staged acceptance plan that guarantees early API access and a prioritized cutover slot in week-of-2028-07-25.
- If acceptance moves past 2028-08-04 (>5 weeks), flag to Leadership for exec review and conditional capacity deprioritization.

Please reply with a quick risk estimate and the language I should send to the customer. Time is short — Anjali asked for our recommendation.

Thanks,
Soin

Soojin — quick read: low-probability of total deal loss but moderate cost risk. Notes:

- Revenue slip exposure: ~4 weeks of recognition slip (~$45k) if we rebaseline to 7/21.
- Capacity: reserved pool holds but we should mark the capacity as committed until 7/21; if they slip beyond 8/04 we should consider reassigning to short-term bursts.
- Support: SE time for extended validation ~1.5 FTE-weeks if we keep them in pilot longer.

Recommend:
1) Offer a one-time 2-week credit (covers partial support cost) + priority cutover window week of 7/25.
2) Staged acceptance language (API smoke + pilot dataset) with clear acceptance criteria in the MAP.
3) Escalation trigger: if full acceptance not completed by 2028-08-05, Sales Leadership reviews and decides on capacity/tiering.

I drafted the short paragraph to send below. Use this wording to externalize.

We can accommodate a 21-day extension to your evaluation period and propose a staged acceptance approach to preserve pricing and prioritization. We will offer a one-time credit equal to two weeks of committed billing and reserve a prioritized cutover slot during the week of July 25. If full acceptance extends beyond August 5, we will schedule an executive review to re-assess commitments and next steps.

- To balance risk, we are offering a one-time credit equal to two weeks of committed billing and a prioritized cutover slot in the week of 2028-07-25.
